$comment: The 2026-08-22 arena art pass. One entry per FIGURE or EFFECT; the agents that run it read
design/art/arena-art-contract.md first. Routes: 'character' = create_character v3 side view +
animate_character v3 on ONE rotation; 'image' = create_image_pixen still + animate_image.
Every strip ends as 8 square 512-px frames; the champion faces RIGHT (south-east rotation),
enemies and bosses face LEFT (south-west rotation / prompted facing left).
style_suffix: Dark fantasy pixel art, full body, clean readable silhouette

archetypes.$comment: Temporal contracts by what the GAME does with a strip (production/qa/evidence/vfx-cohort/taxonomy.md, 2026-09-23). tools/fx_energy.py reads membership from here and runs the matching diagnostic; none of them is a CI gate. Hard rules for every strip stay EDGE + SOFT + LIVE (check_fx_edges.py).

IMPACT.contract: one event: optional build-up, one primary peak, outward breakup, fade. Reject a collapse and second explosion, a loop or reset, a late new central hit.
IMPACT.assembly: OWNER DECISION 2026-09-23: an open-ended IMPACT whose last generated frame comes back empty is assembled from the input frame + generated 1-7 (fxclips.py --impact-from-input; clip.py --from-input). IMPACT policy only: fxclips refuses it for anything also HELD, and it is never applied to fields, marks or shields.

PROJECTILE.contract: OWNER DECISION 2026-09-23 - TWO MOTION LAYERS. World motion: the renderer flies the strip from hunter to target (one pass of the 8 frames over the 1.0 s flight, 8 fps; frames 0-5 are seen, 6-7 sit in the tail fade). Internal motion: the strip itself must visibly change - a blade tumbles, tilts or glints, an orb pulses or flows, a shard tumbles - so it reads as an object moving through the world, not an icon translated across the screen. A picture that only translates is NOT approved. Also: no teleport or reset, no backward jump, no second launch, no size pumping, no disappearing, no full cartoon pinwheel; a subtle trail that stays behind the object and decays is welcome. fx_energy.internal_motion() reports change / turn / glint (never a gate).
PROJECTILE.composite: ADR-010 (2026-09-23, Seeker pilot, awaiting approval): a projectile listed in ProjectileLooks is DRAWN AT RUNTIME from parts - head + short hot core trail + long soft wake + one glint + <=3 sparks + a directional impact - and its strip is not drawn (it stays as the spawn/placement key and the fallback). The trail is made of the projectile's real positions, never baked. BODY-SIZE CONTRACT: head length = HeadLength x caster height, measured on the head's own one-frame texture; the strip's union box, the trail and the wobble never size it. Parts live in assets/art/VFX/parts/ (white, straight alpha), built by fxparts.py: drawn parts (head, glint) from PixelLab through whiten -> glow -> soften -> feather; pure gradients (streak, spark, flash, shard) procedural. Do NOT ask PixelLab for projectile motion, large rotation or a baked trail: the pinned tumble shrank the knife to 40 % through the union box.

parts.fxp_seeker_knife_head: pixen cd704393 (the cohort knife, reused), 512, soften 3, feather 48

TRAP/MARK.contract: establish, read clearly, settle into the intended held form. Energy need not fall after the first peak. No repeated apparent placement, no blink. OWNER DECISION 2026-09-23: a held trap may stay still once established, but its ACTIVATION must read as a physical event - for a snare: appear / establish, then a tighten / tension cue, then the held state. Continuous motion through the held life is not required.
TRAP/MARK.frame_size: OWNER DECISION 2026-09-23: keep the 512 square frame contract; no wider native trap frame in this batch. Traps span the canvas width; on the widest enemy row the renderer's own budget clamp (VfxBudget.Max 1.25) already draws the trap slightly smaller than asked (the Seeker snare at 96 %). If that ever reads too small, it is a world-space trap rendering problem, not an asset-format change.

FIELD/AURA.contract: a HELD loop behind the hunter: one coherent silhouette; breathing and repeated peaks allowed while visually continuous; frame 7 flows into frame 0; no structural reset. Visual language: line-art sigils and runes (fx_aura, fx_wilt), readable behind the champion, never a large opaque prop.
FIELD/AURA.press_direction: OWNER DECISION 2026-09-23: the cohort's square-weight PRESS (0f6a221b) is NOT approved and was reverted. PRESS must be an abstract pressure field - a rune, line-art or force symbol consistent with the other fields - not a literal weight, box or machine. Not regenerated in this pass.

SHIELD/BARRIER.contract: stable main geometry with a modest continuous breath; no respawn; no size jump. The same strip also flares once as a one-shot (gain, absorb, undying).

OTHER.contract: fx_weep is a one-shot rain whose falling streaks are cyclic inside it; fx_bind_chain is a BUILD-screen animation drawn with AlphaBlend, not a HUNT effect.

archetypes.dual_contract: HELD and fired: it must read as a one-shot under the renderer's tail fade AND loop seamlessly when held (frame 7 into frame 0). Marks are held by BRAND (any hunter), fx_tower_strike and fx_unbroken_trap by their champion's signature field.

prompt_rules.$comment: Learned on the fx_seeker_strike pilots, 2026-09-23. The item prompts below PREDATE these rules and have NOT been rewritten yet; apply these when each is regenerated.
prompt_rules.one_event: Describe ONE event with one direction of travel: 'one single impact that happens once', 'the motion only goes outward'. An open-ended animate_image drifts back toward a cycle: three of four open clips collapsed and re-burst in their second half when the prompt only described the look.
prompt_rules.forbid_the_second_hit: Name the failure: 'nothing moves back toward the middle, no second burst, no new shapes appear, it does not repeat or restart'.
prompt_rules.keep_a_remnant: 'the splinters stay clearly visible in every frame including the last one'. Never 'fades out completely': the renderer fades the tail itself, and asking the strip to reach nothing returns empty frames.
prompt_rules.no_literal_emptiness: Never 'empty centre' or 'nothing in the middle' in a SHAPE prompt: pixen painted an opaque transparency checkerboard. Describe what IS there.
prompt_rules.no_disc_words: Never 'round core', 'bright core' or 'glowing centre': pixen draws a solid sun disc. The impact point is 'one point in the centre' at most.
prompt_rules.bold_strokes: Ask for THICK shards ('each shard a long narrow white triangle'). One-pixel needles vanish at the ~0.3x the fight draws an effect (fx_energy LIVE). Bold subjects fill the canvas: accept tips that graze the edge, and let feather take them.
prompt_rules.no_pinned_ending_for_bursts: A pinned last_frame did NOT constrain a burst: the interpolation routed back through the start (1a76308a). Pinning stays right for HELD loops (first = last).
prompt_rules.held_is_pinned_and_flat: HELD (field, shield, and every DUAL strip): pin first = last and describe motion that cannot vanish or flash: 'staying the same size, complete and equally bright in every frame; nothing flashes'. Never ask a held strip to brighten or breathe; the renderer breathes it (barrier 0.40-0.60, field pulse). 'The rings breathe: they glow a little brighter' returned a 3.1x flash (cab1f308).
prompt_rules.impact_ends_empty: An open-ended outward dispersal emptied its last frame in 3 of 8 clips (anvil 1d7971cb, 7ace0477; Seeker 6ae66427), whatever the prompt says. The motion is usually right. Assembling from the input frame plus generated 1-7 rescues it (offline proof on 1d7971cb), but that changes the assembly rule and awaits the owner's decision.
prompt_rules.rigid_objects_barely_move: The image route keeps a rigid object almost still when first = last or open-ended: the knife did not spin (17f76b3d), the snare did not snap shut (72fe5a7a), the weight barely sank (0f6a221b). A PROJECTILE still needs internal motion (owner decision): pin DIFFERENT endpoints - the object at launch and the same object re-posed by edit_image_pixen (tilted) - and the interpolation turns it (7ea56119). Expect it to take the long way round, and expect the rotation to shrink the projectile on screen (sizing is by the union box height).
prompt_rules.props_become_props: A bold object prompt returns a shaded 3D PROP (a hydraulic press, a box with dials, three tyres), and 'symbol' returned an opaque checkerboard. Fields read best as line-art sigils (fx_aura, fx_wilt, the mark). PRESS still needs an identity decision.
prompt_rules.trap_fills_width: A trap is sized to 80 % of the enemy row's WIDTH, so its art must span the canvas width ('stretching across almost the whole width of the picture'). The snare did: 1.50 over budget became 1.10.
prompt_rules.judge_after_the_post_pass: Screen motion on the raw clip, but judge readability only AFTER whiten-glow-soften-feather: the soften step decides which thin parts survive.

$comment: The 2026-09-16 region x archetype matrix: 6 regions x 4 archetypes = 24 normal-enemy identities.
PRESENTATION ONLY — gameplay Source, HP, damage and archetype rolls stay in Core. The key is
<region slug>_<archetype>; clips idle/attack/death; south-west rotation (faces LEFT); 8 x 512 frames.
Archetype reads from the SILHOUETTE: swarm small/busy/low, caster tall/thin/hovering, armoured
closed/plated/heavy centre, bruiser broad/dominant. Scale (ArchetypeScale) is supporting language only.
`done` records the PixelLab ids per key: character route {character_id, idle, attack, death},
image route {image_job, idle_job, attack_job, death_job}. The six 2026-08-22 Source bodies stay in
`enemies` above as history; the matrix supersedes them for the arena.

$comment: The 2026-09-16 rarity-frame family: five pixen 256x256 stills with a TRANSPARENT centre and one
shared band (~1/8 of the width), progressive ornament by tier, hue as the second cue. Replaced the
2026-08 chrome-style frames whose interiors were opaque near-black. The renderer measures the interior
from the texture (ItemArtMetrics.FrameInterior); do not bake an item, text or a checkerboard inside.
ui_frames.template: a square ornate item slot frame border only: {tier}, the border band about one eighth of the width thick on all four sides, the whole centre completely empty and transparent showing nothing, dark fantasy pixel art, no text, no item inside, on empty transparent space with nothing behind it

epic: e6ab69ad-ef56-4092-bc84-3aa492a79461 (band too thin for the family)

items.common: a plain dark iron frame, a simple flat band with slightly worn edges and no ornament, dull grey iron
items.uncommon: a dark iron frame with a thin pale green enamel inlay line running along the band and four small round rivet studs at the corners, muted green and dark iron
items.rare: a dark steel frame with an engraved blue-silver inlay line along the band and small pointed steel brackets at the four corners, cool blue and silver on dark steel
items.epic: a rich dark metal frame with deep violet enamel panels along all four sides and gold scrollwork corner pieces, small violet gems at the corners, violet and gold on dark metal (band about one seventh)
items.legendary: a magnificent gold frame with dense baroque filigree along all four sides, radiating flourishes at the four corners and a small crest at the top centre, warm gold with pale glowing highlights on dark metal

$comment: The 2026-09-16 bespoke prologue plates: one pixen 640x360 still per OpeningScript.Prologue beat, x3
nearest to 1920x1080 (the house plate recipe), filed as assets/art/Environments/prologue/plate_prologue_<id>.png
and keyed by PrologueArt (Game). Composed subject-up / lower-third-quiet for the subtitle; no text; no new canon.
`done` holds the chosen job per beat; `rejected` the candidates that lost and why.
